card: तीन डिग्री: positive (poor), comparative (poorer, दो में), superlative (poorest, सबमें)। लंबे शब्दों में more/most: beautiful, more beautiful, most beautiful। कुछ अलग: good, better, best; bad, worse, worst।

Teen degree: positive (poor), comparative (poorer, do mein), superlative (poorest, sabmein). Lambe shabdon mein more/most: beautiful, more beautiful, most beautiful. Kuchh alag: good, better, best; bad, worse, worst.
Three degrees: positive (poor), comparative (poorer, of two), superlative (poorest, of all). Long words use more/most. Some are different: good, better, best; bad, worse, worst.
